turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Good morning. Let's start with some basics. How old are you?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: I'm thirty-eight. Hi, sorry, it's been a long morning already.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: That's okay. Are you married, single, or living common-law?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: I'm married. My husband and I have been together for twelve years.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: How many children do you have, and how old are they?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: We have two kids. Our daughter is four and our son is nine.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Thanks. Can you tell me about your household income?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: My husband is the only one working right now. I think our household brings in about forty-eight thousand a year.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Great. Do you own your home or rent?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: We rent. It's fifteen hundred a month, sorry, fourteen hundred... no, it's fifteen hundred.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: Thanks for clarifying. Do you get the Canada Child Benefit?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: Yes, we get it every month for both kids.

turns.speaker: staff
turns.text: When did you last file your taxes?

turns.speaker: client
turns.text: We filed for last year, so for 2025, back in the spring.
